title: Kagurabachi Fans Have Nothing But Praise for the Anime’s Early Premiere
content: Kagurabachi has officially made its early premiere to lucky fans in attendance during the Anime Expo 2026 weekend , and it’s been a big hit with fans by the looks of their immediate reactions to the event.
author: ComicBook

title: MURCIÉLAGO TV Anime Announced for 2027, HIDIVE Confirms Exclusive Streaming
content: Kana Yoshimura’s long-running action manga MURCIÉLAGO is officially getting a TV anime adaptation in 2027, more than a decade after the series debuted in Young Gangan . The announcement was made at Anime Expo 2026 with a super teaser trailer, key visual, and the first production details.
author: Anime Corner

title: Shonen Jump Anime Confirms Season 2 Crunchyroll Release Date With New Trailer – Watch
content: A major Shonen Jump franchise is heading back to Crunchyroll for Season 2 of the anime later this month, and has finally confirmed its release date with a cool new trailer showing off a full look at the series in action.
author: ComicBook

title: 8 Years Later, Classic Action Manga Returns From Hiatus With New Look
content: The critically acclaimed action drama manga, Gangsta. , written and illustrated by Kohsuke, has finally returned after an indefinite hiatus. The manga began serialization in Shinchosha’s Comic@Bunch magazine in 2011 and became one of the best action series of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Confirms New Anime for 2026 And Beyond
content: It should come as no surprise that this year’s Anime Expo had a big role for Crunchyroll to play, with the streaming service still the biggest platform that exclusively focuses on anime.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Is Now Streaming The Best Anime From Dandadan’s Studio
content: Science SARU, the studio behind Dandadan , has released several unique anime films and series ever since its establishment in 2013. While the studio was fairly well-known in the industry before Dandadan , its popularity only skyrocketed after its major Shonen Jump hit.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece to Increase Manga Price (But Don’t Worry)
content: One Piece might have taken the world of anime and live-action by storm in recent years, but all these Straw Hat Pirate stories erupt from the works of Eiichiro Oda. Ever since the late 1990s, the manga artist has worked tirelessly to release the story of Monkey D. Luffy and his fellow crewmates weekly.
author: ComicBook

title: Surprise Crunchyroll Isekai Confirms Season 2 Return With First Look
content: A quiet Crunchyroll Isekai anime series has now confirmed that it’s coming back for a second season two years after the end of its original debut. There have been quite a few Isekai anime franchises that have gotten a ton of attention over the years, but there are just as many that have gone under the radar.
author: ComicBook

title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Reveals 2nd Promo Video, Theme Song Artists
content: The staff for the second television anime season based on Nigojū and Umibōzu 's The Detective Is Already Dead ( Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. ) light novel series unveiled the anime's second promotional video, theme song artists, and new character visuals on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Akane-banashi Anime Reveals 6 More Dub Cast Members
content: • Kari Wahlgren as Urara Ransaika • Greg Chun as Ryu'un Kenputei • Ben Diskin as Chocho Konjakutei • SungWon Cho as Miroku Kashiwaya • Crispin Freeman as Shomei Tsubakiya • Keith Silverstein as Enso Sanmeitei The anime will get a second season in January 2027.
author: ANN
